objective: Characterize and compute exact two-port summaries for guarded positive blocks whose conditional pads can be simultaneously released. Determine which require zero, one or two directed implications in addition to unary values; include size bounds, witnesses and realizability.
status: Proved: A positive implication block reports unary pins and reachability among shared middles. For two ports, ten rectangular reports, two single directions, and equality are exactly attainable with simultaneously releasable pads; the unforced equality first occurs with three stages.
title: Exact reports for two shared middles on positive implication blocks
